The thermal capacity of the cylinder is 89 J / °C.

content.html: As the temperature of the metal cylinder decreases, the volume of the metal decreases. The decrease in the volume of the metal is much less than the decrease in the volume of the gas. Explain, in terms of the particles of the metal, why the decrease in the volume of the metal is less than that of the gas.
